get.description: Returns a list of all Meetings for a specified Project.

parameters.name: deleted_only
parameters.description: Indicates whether to only show deleted meetings. When this query parameter is passed the response body will be an array of meetings without grouping. i.e. { "meetings":[{Meeting_1}, {Meeting_2}] }

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description:
The data set that should be returned from the serializer.
The normal view includes default fields.
The extended view includes the default fields plus Meeting Template fields.
Default view is normal.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.description: A group of Meetings that belong to the same series, keyed by the series title.

group_title.description: Title of the meeting series this group represents.

meetings.description: Meetings in this series, ordered within the group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Meeting. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to fetch details via `/rest/v1.0/meetings/{id}`.

meeting_template_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting Template this Meeting was created from. Null when the Meeting was not created from a template.

position.description: Ordering of the Meeting within its series; lower values sort first.

created_by_id.description: Login Information (user) ID of the Meeting's creator. Only populated for meetings created after Dec 2023.

description.description: Plain-text overview of the Meeting, with any rich-text markup stripped.
description.example: Stuff is going to go down aka ticket eating

mode.description: Whether the Meeting is currently in agenda or minutes mode. Constrained to the values in the enum.

meeting_date.description: Calendar date the Meeting takes place.

parent_id.description: Identifier of the previous Meeting in the series, or null for the first Meeting.

location.description: Where the Meeting takes place. Null when no location is set.

meeting_topics_count.description: Number of agenda/minutes topics associated with this Meeting.

occurred.description: Indicates whether this meeting has already taken place.

is_private.description: Indicates whether this meeting is only visible to scheduled attendees and users with 'Admin' level permissions to the Meetings tool.

distributed_at.description: Timestamp when the Meeting's agenda or minutes were last distributed. Null if never distributed.

last_distributed_event.description: Which document was distributed most recently. Constrained to the values in the enum; null if never distributed.

distributed_by.description: The Project user who last distributed the Meeting's agenda or minutes. Null if never distributed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Meeting was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Meeting was last updated.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

x-changelog.summary: Adds filters[query] and filters[search] query parameters
x-changelog.description:
Adds filters[query] and filters[search] to the List Meetings endpoint. Both perform a
case-insensitive partial match on the meeting title and behave identically, following the
platform search-box convention. Unrecognized filters were previously ignored, so the search
box returned all meetings.
